en: A multi-view color postcard showing various landmarks of the city of Pécs. The main images include a large square with a domed former mosque in the center, surrounded by historic buildings and parked cars; a night view of the same domed building; a Romanesque cathedral with four towers and a statue in the foreground; some stone ruins in a green park; and a modern-looking building set among trees. The word "PÉCS" is printed prominently on the front. The back shows handwritten Hungarian text, a red Magyar Posta stamp, and address lines.
